name: loan_to_income
rationale: Captures affordability: how large the requested loan is relative to the borrower's income.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.
notes: annual_inc == 0 mapped to NaN to avoid division by zero.

name: dti_x_loan_to_income
rationale: Interaction between existing debt load and the new loan's relative size. Captures compounding leverage.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.

name: credit_hist_months
rationale: Longer credit history is a proxy for financial stability.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.
notes: reference_date defaults to per-row issue_d (funding month). Excluded from pre-pricing regression: no verified application date. Use baseline mo_sin_old_rev_tl_op for that task instead.

name: revol_util_bucket
rationale: Utilisation risk is known to be non-linear; binning exposes threshold effects without a learned transformation.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.

name: total_credit_lines
rationale: Depth of the credit file; a coarse proxy for how much history the bureau has on the borrower.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.

name: inquiries_per_open_account
rationale: Recent credit-seeking intensity relative to the active credit file.
missing_handling: Missing inputs and zero denominator -> NaN; fold-wise imputation.

name: util_x_fico
rationale: Joint signal: high utilisation is more dangerous at low FICO than at high FICO.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.

name: bc_pressure
rationale: Bank-card pressure: high utilisation with little available headroom is a strong stress indicator.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.
notes: bc_open_to_buy == 0 mapped to NaN before division.

name: delinq_rate
rationale: Normalised delinquency: raw counts are unfair to borrowers with deep credit files.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.

name: loan_per_term
rationale: Monthly principal burden at origination; captures the pace at which the borrower must repay.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.

name: emp_length_years
rationale: Employment stability; a well-known underwriting input.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.
notes: 0.5 is a fixed midpoint convention for <1 year; 10 is the lower bound for 10+ years. Missing strings remain NaN.

name: has_bankruptcy
rationale: Binary signal of past bankruptcy; more stable than the raw count which is highly skewed.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.

name: closed_credit_share
formula: (total_acc - open_acc) / total_acc; invalid counts or total_acc <= 0 -> NaN
rationale: Share of the historical credit file no longer open; captures account turnover.
missing_handling: Missing or inconsistent counts -> NaN; fold-wise imputation.

name: installment_burden
rationale: Annualised repayment burden as a share of income.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.
notes: Excluded from regression because installment is derived from loan_amnt, term, and int_rate and is banned for that task.

name: rate_burden
rationale: Dollar cost of the loan's first-year interest; a direct measure of how burdensome the priced loan is.
missing_handling: NaN preserved; imputed inside the training-fold pipeline.
notes: Excluded from regression because int_rate is the target for that task; it is allowed for the origination classifier because the priced rate is fixed at origination.
